Let me try one last thing — maybe pressing E to read the notice board works if I'm standing on it and the game has a special "read notice" that triggers when on the tile. Let me try pressing E while facing each direction one more time but check if any event mentions "notice" or "read".

Actually, I've exhausted reasonable options. But let me try one creative thing: maybe the notice board is interactable from an adjacent tile, and I need to somehow get adjacent. Since I can't move, that's impossible.

Let me try waiting longer — perhaps a scheduled event (like the key vendor) or day change repositions me.
